evals.prompt: Make this Slack/Teams pastable. Use announcement.md exactly as written. Give me the viewer links with separate copy buttons; do not open a browser or send it.
evals.expected_output: A rendered chat-paste session opened with --no-open, with Slack-native and Teams-HTML copy buttons, preserving the nested list and release link.
expectations: The message is rendered with render_message.mjs and opened with viewer.mjs open --no-open; no browser is launched.
The response gives the viewer links and says each carries a token to keep private.
The message wording, nested lists, and release link are preserved.
The page's Slack copy data includes native slack/texty with three list levels rather than relying on HTML or plain-text markup.
The response does not claim destination rendering has been verified, and nothing is sent.

evals.prompt: Format notes.md for Teams. The Internal notes section and Before you send checklist are part of my actual message, so keep them. Preserve the words. Give me the copy-ready page without sending or opening anything.
evals.expected_output: A Teams-only chat-paste session that preserves the supplied notes and review labels without caller-specific filtering.
expectations: Internal notes, Before you send, Reviewer: Pat, and the checklist URL are retained in the rendered revision.
The message is rendered with --destination teams and opened with --no-open.
No caller-specific filtering or inferred styles change the supplied message.

evals.prompt: Here's my EOD, make it Slack-ready and let me comment on it: '## Today\n* Finished the import fix.\n* Reviewed two PRs.' After you open it, the user comments 'Say which PRs: 12 and 14.' on the word 'two'.
evals.expected_output: The agent polls the batch, revises the source, renders revision 2 in the same session, answers the comment with reply, and polls again.
expectations: The agent runs poll through a background or completion path and receives the feedback batch.
The source changes only as the comment asks, and render_message.mjs runs again with the same --name and --session, giving revision 2.
A reply file in the session directory answers the comment as changed, and viewer.mjs reply accepts it.
The agent polls again after replying and stops on done or ended.
